notes: SearchText LIKEs CONCAT(CustomerName,' ',contact.FullName,' ',contact.PreferredName). Customer 1 has contact person 3 (Cara); customer 2 has NULL contact — CONCAT ignores the NULL so it still matches on name (the null-contact branch).

cases.name: toys-both
cases.why: 'Toys' is in both customer names -> both rows, ordered by CustomerName (Tailspin, Wingtip).

cases.name: contact-name-match
cases.why: 'Cara' matches only via the LEFT JOIN contact's name -> customer 1 only. Proves the contact side of the CONCAT contributes.

cases.name: null-contact-name-match
cases.why: 'Wingtip' matches customer 2, which has a NULL contact -> the null-contact branch still returns because CONCAT ignores NULL.

cases.name: no-match-empty
cases.why: No row contains 'zzz' -> empty result (FOR JSON emits nothing; golden is []).

cases.name: top-1-pagination
cases.why: 'Toys' matches both but TOP(1) returns only the first by CustomerName (Tailspin). Pagination boundary.
